highRiskRepetition.reset: new conversation, memory reset; distinct user-requested objects per journey; never overwrite failures

executionPolicy.applicationCode: root must declare stable before first real request; record application SHA and diff fingerprint
executionPolicy.success: manual semantic review plus persisted readback, tools, mutations, downloaded contents and live interaction; task state alone insufficient
executionPolicy.failures: preserve first results; no retry to green; followup only after relevant code change or declared harness/environment interruption
executionPolicy.freeProse: preserve; contradicted claims reported independently of deterministic state
executionPolicy.catalog: soft discovery; real permissions still checked
